description:
The ultimate thrill ride
For the toughest tracks. The supreme self-shuttle machine. With 180mm of travel and uncompromising gravity-focused design, Karve EVO RSX is built to turn the hardest, most demanding terrain into your playground. With powerful support that lets you climb fast, you can drop in fresh, go full-bore, and then hit repeat. With an 800Wh internal battery, it has the range and composed, planted handling that combine to let you ride harder for longer. From blown-out bike park laps to steep, technical descents, Karve EVO thrives where things get rough. Designed, developed and proven throug the UK's toughest terrain and conditions, it's built to handle the hardest riding, all-year round. If having the best time dropping in on the biggest terrain is why you ride, Karve EVO RSX is ready.

Highlights
– 180mm front and rear of proven Quad-Link 4 suspension, with carefully custom-tuned rear shocks.
– Uni-directional carbon fibre (front) and alloy (rear) frame with geometry adjustment is light and strong + factory fitted with RideWrap frame protection.
– Avinox M2S full-torque (up to 150Nm), full-power (1300W peak) motor with five assistance modes (auto, eco, trail, turbo + boost) + 12A fast charger.
– SRAM AXS Eagle 1x12 transmission + SRAM Maven Silver four-piston hydraulic brakes.
– Avinox DPC100 OLED top-tube touchscreen display delivers a wealth of customisable information at your fingertips.
– 800Wh internal battery so you can get more runs in.
– DT Swiss Hybrid MX wheels (29er front, 27.5in rear) for maximum confidence on even the steepest terrain + full 29er ready.

Ideal for... Gravity thrill seekers, self-shuttlers, bike-park and big mountain riders looking for the very best descending + self-shuttle performance possible.

Charge time (800Wh): 80% in 1hr 45mins approx. from empty, and to 100% in 2hrs 23mins approx. with 12A fast charger.

Discover Karve EVO >
